_comment: Explicit resolutions for ShabadOS SGGS lines the matcher cannot place automatically.
Each entry maps ONE ShabadOS line id to the list of OUR verbatim lines.id values it
corresponds to, in printed order. An empty list means the line's text is already
covered by the previous entry (the two editions break the same text differently).
Every entry carries a reason. This file never changes scripture — only pointers.

overrides.reason: Line break differs: our edition prints 'ਅੰਨੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ … ਲੂਣੁ ਪੰਜਵਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਿਰਤੁ ॥' then 'ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਕੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ॥'; ShabadOS breaks after ਲੂਣੁ. Both of our lines cover DWWY + VHZ5 exactly once.
Spelling of the subjoined ha: our edition prints ਇਕਨ੍ਹੀ / ਚੁਲ੍ਹੈ / ਰਹਨ੍ਹਿ (੍ਹ); ShabadOS writes the udaat sign (ੑ). Same words; below the fuzzy threshold because three tokens differ.
